purpose: Freeze all Stage B scientific logic, outcome alignment, statistics, promotion gates, and upstream blind artifacts before opening any previously unseen per-instance outcome data.

frozen_promotion_gates.G1_magnitude: ERFA Spearman correlation with absolute effect >= 0.60 and task-block permutation p < 0.01
frozen_promotion_gates.G2_materiality: ERFA materiality AUROC >= 0.75 and sealed-threshold sensitivity >= 0.65 and specificity >= 0.65
frozen_promotion_gates.G3_adaptive_value: task-bootstrap 95% lower confidence bound for ERFA AUROC minus the best baseline AUROC > 0
frozen_promotion_gates.G4_cross_selector: ERFA AUROC exceeds the best baseline AUROC separately in both selector families
frozen_promotion_gates.G5_selective_fallback: harmful exact/near excess regret reduced by >= 0.50 with active-mode coverage >= 0.50
frozen_promotion_gates.G6_nonvacuity_control: at least one third of diverse controls remain low risk and ERFA AUROC exceeds count-distance AUROC
